title: Test Coverage & Regression Verification
description: Achieve ≥80% test coverage for all M10 modules. Write integration tests validating agent end-to-end flows. Verify no regression in existing M1-M9 capabilities by running full test suite.
action: Write integration tests for: (1) RevisionOrchestrator full loop with mocked LLM responses, (2) StyleExtractor + ContextAssembler pipeline, (3) CrossChapterConsistencyChecker with multi-chapter test fixtures, (4) M10 API client functions. Run full test suites for both desktop and src-ts to verify no regressions.
read_first: desktop/src/api/core.ts (reference: callApi mock pattern for tests)

criteria: All M10 unit test files exist: revision-orchestrator.test.ts, style-profile.test.ts, consistency-engine.test.ts, context-assembler.test.ts
convergence.verification: Run full test suites for both src-ts and desktop. Check that all new tests pass and existing tests are not broken.
convergence.definition_of_done: ≥80% test coverage for all M10 modules. Full test suite passes with no regressions.

files.change: Full loop test: mock LLM returning incremental scores, verify convergence, verify revert on degradation
Extraction metrics, profile persistence, style injection into prompt
Multi-chapter test fixtures with known conflicts, verify all detection methods
Context assembly with entity mentions, story bible integration
Test all M10 API client functions with mocked callApi responses

implementation: Ensure all unit test files from TASK-001/002/003 are comprehensive. Add missing edge cases: empty text, single character text, very long text, text with no dialogue, text with only dialogue.

Write integration test for RevisionOrchestrator full loop: mock the evaluation API to return scores [6.0, 7.5, 8.2], mock the revision API to return improved text, verify the orchestrator converges at iteration 3.

Write integration test for StyleExtractor → ContextAssembler pipeline: extract style from sample text, verify profile metrics, then pass profile to context assembler and verify context string includes style guidance.

Write integration test for CrossChapterConsistencyChecker with 3-chapter test fixture containing: name conflict (character referred differently), timeline issue (event ordering), unresolved thread (plot element introduced but not resolved), trait drift (character changes personality).
Write API client tests for desktop/src/api/m10-apis.ts: mock callApi, verify each function sends correct endpoint and payload.
Run full test suites: npm test --prefix src-ts && cd desktop && npm test
Verify no regression: all existing tests still pass

reference.pattern: Follow existing test patterns from desktop/src/api/*.test.ts and src-ts test files

rationale.chosen_approach: Dedicated test task ensures comprehensive coverage after all implementation is complete, avoiding the overhead of maintaining tests during rapid development.
rationale.tradeoffs: Test task at the end risks discovering integration issues late — mitigate by having basic unit tests in each implementation task

risks: Integration issues discovered late may require going back to earlier tasks — mitigate with unit tests in each task
